title: serve_mvp Supervisor Defect — Platform Escalation Request
author: Atlas (Infrastructure & DevOps Director) / SRE (System Optimizer)

defects.description: False-negative boot-health detection: wrapper reports SERVER BOOT FAILED while child HTTP logs show successful HTTP 200
Abandoned child process leak: after false negative, wrapper abandons live server instead of killing it
Broken log-tail retrieval: logs exist at created path but retrieval returns nothing

root_cause: Platform-supervisor wrapper defect, NOT agent/config issue. Reproduced across 3 envs including DB-registered env_2f41d73c.
interim_workaround: Port-mapped env env_71403ac3 (container 82c91b332f33) provisioned for Developer with ports 55128/55130
